FacebookFacebook MessengerTwitterEmail ORCHARD PARK, N.Y. -- — Josh Allen wasn't in an I-told-you-so mood after he threw three touchdown passes ... Following a few clunkers, Allen led the Buffalo Bills to a season high in points in Sunday's 44-32 win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers — and afterward, he refused to fall into the trap of riding emotional peaks and ... “Starting off 4-0 and we're the best team in the world. And we lose two in a row and now we're the worst team in the ... Allen became the first NFL’s first player with two games of three TDs passing and rushing. He did it last year in a 44-42 loss at the Los Angeles Rams . He also upped his career total to 290 touchdowns, the most by a quarterback before turning 30 — passing Peyton Manning’s 288. ... Buffalo (7-3) resembled the team that beat Kanas City 28-21 and Carolina 40-9 coming out of its bye week, rather than ...
